why: Own pages carry authorname:dkwasniewski, but LibreTexts has no author record for that name, so the page footer printed "authored, remixed, and/or curated by ." The free-text author@ tag fills the footer on the web and in the PDF (tested on 597232, single-page compile).
method: GET /@api/deki/pages/{id}/tags, PUT the same list plus the one tag; every list read back as planned; no page body changed
not_touched: pages tagged authorname:anonymous (Ball, 78), authorname:mmalik (15), NC-SA pages with no author tag (597082, 597128-597130, 597155, 597171) and six container pages with no footer (488225-488228, 488230, 488233)
